provenance: Authored bilingual regression cases; no empirical extraction, independent annotation or heldout generalization claim.
evidence: Manually executed all six pinned ONNX bundles through the production isolated worker on 2026-11-17. Raw vectors are archived here for offline recomputation; file hashes establish artifact identity, not independent execution attestation.

Instruct: Given a search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
Query:

models.floorProtocol: ceil((strongest measured answer-removed cosine + 0.001) * 1e6) / 1e6; capped at 1
models.marginProtocol: The shipped margin is a fixed policy limit. The proposal reports the smallest margin supported by this single-answer dataset; it does not establish an optimal multi-answer margin.
models.limitation: Same authored regression set selects and measures these rules; no heldout or production false-positive guarantee. Answer-removed controls contain only the seven original non-answer passages. Margin support is limited by the relevant labels in this dataset.

Answer-removed controls have seven passages. No external annotations, real PDF extraction, heldout evaluation, throughput or production-wide false-positive assurance.
